title: Git, GitHub, and Project Workflow Basics
learning_objectives: Explain what version control is and why Git is used
Initialize a Git repository and make commits
Create a GitHub repository and push local commits
Describe a simple GitHub Flow: main branch plus feature branches
outline: Version control and why it matters
Core Git concepts: repository, commit, history
Creating a local repo for the P1 project
Connecting to GitHub and pushing changes
Very light introduction to branches and pull requests

format: Git history showing multiple meaningful commits
GitHub repository containing the Phase 1 project files

constraints_for_professor: Use command-line Git where possible, with minimal GUIs
Keep branching model simple: main + one feature branch example
